queries.rationale: Idea 2 introduced muP-like width-aware output scaling and idea 3 a W=m*V hidden-layer reparametrization; muP is the literature behind both.

queries.query: effective learning rate width scaling normalization weight decay AdamW
queries.rationale: Idea 3 tests an effective-learning-rate confound in width; decoupled weight decay (AdamW) and effective-LR dynamics are needed to interpret it.

queries.query: memorization capacity of models bits per parameter
queries.rationale: Memorization-capacity crossover hypothesis (t_mem falls with width, critical width scales with train fraction) needs capacity-estimation and memorization-dynamics work.

result_driven_themes: final sealed evaluation: fitted log-delay vs width slope -0.020 with bootstrap CI [-0.58, 0.35] spanning zero, vs reference slope -0.37; 40% of runs censored (no grokking within budget) -> conditional/inconclusive width effect
held-out controls (shuffled labels) stay near chance (max val acc ~0.012), so detected generalization is genuine
effective-learning-rate confound between width and delay under reparametrization
